scene_worlds.layout: Right-handed metres: ground y=0, camera initially (0,1.15,6), hollow centre (0.2,1.2,0), fern contact (-0.08,1.05,0.16), foreground leaf (-0.35,1.15,4.1), distant canopy z=-5. Camera stays in front of the hollow. Layout is a proposal, not measured geometry.
scene_worlds.perspective: Same spatial trunk, ground, hollow and contact plane in all shots; camera narrows the view, never replaces the clearing. 2D sprites stay inside their authored front/three-quarter view range.
scene_worlds.lighting: Cool diffuse canopy light from upper left; insect contributes a local ivory glint, recognized eyes warm to restrained amber. All assets agree.
scene_worlds.crop_safety: Keep hollow/eye mask within the central 65% during macro; foreground may occlude intentionally. Closest bark use is 0.45 m. Wet trace remains distinguishable at intended output size.
scene_worlds.occlusion_rules: watcher_eyes is behind the physical hollow rim; ambiguous glints do not expose eyelids before S4. entry_leaf masks the same aperture on withdrawal.
